description: Every binding governed by this identifier names §1's identifier and carries either a `selector` that is one `Name` under §2.1.9 of the governing edition naming exactly one operation definition of its source's carried document, or no `selector` over a document holding exactly one operation definition.
notes: Decidable offline from the carried document alone; resolution and refusal phases are the processor's under GQL-P-05.
